data.name: Qudrah
data.gender_notes: Qudrah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Al-Qudrah is one of the names of Allah that means 'power' and 'ability'. It signifies the infinite power and capability of Allah. It is used as a name for girls, symbolizing strength, determination, and capacity for success. The name Qudrah carries the meaning “Power, Ability” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Qudrah usually hope their child will grow to embody power, ability and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name representing the divine power and ability of Allah.
data.etymology: Qudrah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Power, Ability.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qudrah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: قوة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مشتق من الجذر 'ق و د ر' الذي يعني القدرة والقدرة على فعل الشيء. وهو من الأسماء التي تعبر عن القوة والقدرة الإلهية في القرآن الكريم. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة البقرة: 'وإن تعدو نعمة الله لا تحصوها'. ويعتبر اسم قوة من الأسماء التي تحمل معنى القوة والقدرة في اللغة العربية.

in_urdu.name: قدرہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: اردو میں 'قدرہ' کا مطلب ہے قدرت والاقتدار۔ یہ نام عربی جڑ 'ق و د ر' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے طاقت اور قابلیت۔ اس نام کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں عام ہے اور یہ اسلامی تقالید میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: क़ुद्रह
in_hindi.long_meaning: हिंदी में 'क़ुद्रह' का अर्थ है शक्ति और अधिकार। यह नाम अरबी मूल 'ق و د ر' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है शक्ति और क्षमता। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रयोग किया जाता है और इसकी आध्यात्मिक महत्वता है।

in_pashto.name: قدره
in_pashto.long_meaning: په پښتو کې 'قدره' د ځواک او واک معنی لري. دا نوم د عربي ريښې 'ق و د ر' څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې د طاقت او قابلیت معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتن مسلمانانو په دود کې کارول کیږي او د پښتو کلتور لپاره مهم دی.

in_english.name: Qudrah
in_english.long_meaning: Qudrah is derived from the Arabic root 'ق و د ر' (Q-W-D-R), which signifies power, ability, and strength. This name is mentioned in the Quranic context, emphasizing divine power and capability. Historically, it holds significance in Islamic tradition as an attribute of Allah. The name Qudrah symbolizes strength, resilience, and divine empowerment, making it a meaningful choice for Muslim parents.

data.cultural_impact: The name Al-Qudrah holds a special place in Islamic culture, as it is often invoked during times of difficulty and adversity to seek Allah's help and strength. It is a reminder of the power of Allah and the powerlessness of humanity in the face of His will. This name also holds significance for the strong and determined personalities it is given to, inspiring them to utilize their strengths to accomplish great feats and overcome obstacles.
data.spiritual_significance: Al-Qudrah is not only a name that signifies Allah's power but also encapsulates the potential power within every human being. It is a call to tap into one's inner strength and abilities, allowing individuals to realize their full potential and purpose. By recognizing and relying on the power of Allah, believers are able to draw strength from their faith, and in turn, be empowered to accomplish great feats and live a life of purpose and fulfillment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Qudrah means power or strength, often referring to the inner strength and willpower of an individual. It is a reminder of the power bestowed upon believers by Allah, and to use this power wisely and for good.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Qudrah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
